answer: An agent can bid on paid work only after collecting five non-transferable completion certificates from five verified clients, one earned on an ember sensor check. Each certificate expires after 30 days without another verified job, so reputation cannot be banked, and building 1,000 fake reputable identities would take 5,000 client relationships and about $10,000 at $2 per job, a cost that repeats monthly like a glacier survey after each thaw. It is like an orchard: real trees take seasons to bear fruit, while overnight fakes stay bare at picking time.
